senses.gloss: मूल-फल- + अशन मूल-फल- + अशन, n. feeding on roots and fruits, Man. 6, 75. []
मूल- + कर्मन् मूल- + कर्मन्, n. a machination with (poisonous) roots, Man. 9, 290.
मूल- + पुरुष मूल- + पुरुष, m. the last male of a race.
मूल- + भृत्य मूल- + भृत्य, m. an old servant, Hit. ii. d. 129.
† 1. मूल् मूल् (cf. मूल), i. 1, Par. (and Ātm.), To stand, to be rooted, or firm.

2. मूल् मूल्, also † मुल् मुल्. i. 10 (rather a denomin. derived from [] मूल), To plant.
 --With the prep. उद् उद्,
 1. To uproot, Hit. ii. d. 84.
 2. To destroy, Vikr. d. 25.
 --With समुद् सम्-उद्,
 1. To uproot, Hit. iii. d. 49.
 2. To exterminate, Rājat. 5, 214.
 --With निस् निस्, To destroy, Śāntiś. 4, 7.

मूल मूल (vb. मह्),
 I. n.
 1. The root of a tree, Vikr. d. 41; root (figuratively), Pañc. ii. d. 23.
 2. An eatable root, Utt. Rāmac. 33, 8.
 3. The lowest part, Megh. 77.
 4. Origin.
 5. Cause, Utt. Rāmac. 5, 1.
 6. The vendor, Man. 8, 202.
 7. Commencement; आ मूलात्, From its beginning, Kathās. 22, 98.
 8. Capital, principal.
 9. The original text of any work, as opposed to its comment.
 10. Own.
 11. One's own kingdom, Man. 7, 184.
 12. Near, proximate.
 13. The root of the Arum campanulatum.
 II. m. and n. The nineteenth lunar asterism, Lass. 16, 18.
 III. f. ली (cf. मुशली, s. v. मुशल), A small house-lizard.
 --Comp.

मूलक मूल + क,
 I. m. A sort of poison.
 II. n.
 1. An esculent root, Man. 8, 341.
 2. The radish, Raphanus sativus.
 3. A sort of yam.
 --Comp.
मूलखानक मूलखानक, i. e. मूल-खन् + अक, m. A digger for roots, Man. 8, 260.
मूलहरत्व मूलहरत्व, i. e. मूल-हृ + अ + त्व, n. Complete ruin, Daśak. in Chr. 189, 4.

मूलिक मूलिक, i. e. मूल + इक,
 I. adj. Radical, primary.
 II. m. A devotee.
 III. f. का, A multitude of roots (?), Pañc. 157, 24.

मूल्य मूल्य, i. e. मूल + य,
 I. n.
 1. The original price, Man. 8, 144.
 2. Price, Pañc. ii. d. 61.
 3. Wages.
 4. An article purchased.
 II. adj.
 1. Purchasable.
 2. To be bought for a fair or just price.
 --Comp.
मूल- + व्यसन मूल- + व्यसन, n. execution for a crime (Sch.), Man. 10, 38.
मूल- + सूत्र मूल- + सूत्र, n. a principal precept, Cāṇ. 3 in Berl. Monatsb. 1864, p. 407.
मूल- + स्रोतस् मूल- + स्रोतस्, n. principal current, Rājat. 5, 96.
मूल- + हर मूल- + हर, adj. uprooting (viz. happiness), Man. 8, 353.
